thread:
matt: FYI - canary perf alert after the 2026-03-15 release: decode p95 up ~35% on short sequences (<8). Saw it in nightly and in canary traffic. commit abcdef1 merged yesterday. perf job: https://ci.redwood/perf/decode-p95/jobs/342

jun: Noted. Is that the PR that changed the attention kernel selection heuristic? (#5421)

matt: Yes, #5421 updated kernel_selector to prefer attn_v2 for small batch sizes. We thought it was faster but canary shows decode tail increase.

sarah: Profiling snapshot attached (flame snippet pasted):
```
flame: decode_path -> attn_v2::forward (p95 hotspots)
ctx: shortseqs (len 4-6)
obs: attn_v2 spends more time on contiguous transpose + memcopy on these shapes
```

ci-bot: nightly-perf: decode-p95 regression detected (+34%). Full diff: https://ci.redwood/perf/diff/342/343

alex: This is a rollout blocker for the release. Two possible actions: 1) hot-revert the selector change, 2) patch runtime to force attn_v1 for shortseqs while we bisect. Revert has risk of churn.

sanjay: I dug into KV cache traces — when batches are tiny the prefetch loop interleaves with attn_v2 memory ops and can cause small stalls (seen as tail spikes). Not a deadlock but increased stall time on memcopy. Might explain the p95.

matt: That matches the flame. Can we do a cheap runtime flag to force old kernel for seq_len <=8? If so we can ship fix quickly.

jun: I can bisect but agree hotfix first. Propose: set KERNEL_OVERRIDE_SHORTSEQ=attn_v1 in runtime config and push a config-only deploy to canary. If that brings p95 back, we'll revert #5421 or refine heuristic.

alex: Agreed. I'll open a hotfix PR with the flag and a short-term rollout plan. Patch will be config-only:
```
# runtime config patch
kernel_selector:
  shortseq_override: "attn_v1"  # seq_len <= 8
```

ops-bot: deploy job scheduled: infra/deploys/runtime-canary-hotfix #786 -> started

ci-bot: perf job queued against hotfix canary: https://ci.redwood/perf/job/789

jun: I'll start the bisect once hotfix confirms. Candidate range: commits abc1234..abcdef1 (kernel selector refactor + small batch heuristics).

matt: Sounds good. Triage notes: hold rollouts for this release until canary perf stabilizes. If hotfix reduces p95 by ~30% we consider it safe to continue and follow with targeted kernel selector tweaks.

sarah: I'll prepare a minimal repro harness (shortseq load generator) and share traces for the bisect steps.

matt: Thanks everyone. Action items: alex PR hotfix, ops deploy canary, jun bisect, sarah repro & traces. We'll reconvene on thread when perf job finishes. :thumbsup:
